brand.name: Common Room
brand.oneLiner: Get into a university abroad with help from students who just did it.
brand.subline: A plan built around you, simple tools for every step, and mentors from your part of the world. Made for students whose school has no college counselor.

problem: Most schools in Vietnam, India and the UAE have no college counselor.
Agencies charge thousands and hand everyone the same school list.
Free advice online is written for American students, not for you.

faq.a: Our mentors got in within the last few years, many from the same kind of school and with the same money worries as you. They know what changed recently. We check every admission letter and train each mentor before their first session.
No. Nobody honest can promise an admission. What we promise is the work: a clear plan, deadlines you won't miss, and feedback within 48 hours.
Tell us within 7 days of a session. We'll refund it or match you with a different mentor, whichever you prefer.

cssSteps.title: Before you start
cssSteps.intro: The CSS Profile takes most families 2 to 3 hours. Collect papers first so you can do it in one sitting.
items: Your parents' income papers for the last two years
Bank statements and savings totals
The value of any home or land your family owns
A note of the exchange rate you will use (use the same one everywhere)

cssSteps.title: Student details
cssSteps.intro: Your own information: name, citizenship, school and any money in your name.
items: Use your name exactly as it is in your passport
Pick "international student" for citizenship
Include savings in your name, even small amounts

cssSteps.title: Parents and household
cssSteps.intro: Who lives at home and who supports you. This is where most mistakes happen.
items: List everyone who lives with you, including grandparents
Count siblings who are also in school
Each parent's job and employer
cssSteps.headsUp: Most students miss this field if their parents are separated. Many schools also want information from the parent you don't live with. Check each school's rules before you skip it.

cssSteps.title: Parent income
cssSteps.intro: Salaries, business income and anything else your family earns in a year.
items: Enter yearly totals, not monthly
Include cash income from a family business
Write a short note if income changes a lot from year to year

cssSteps.title: Assets
cssSteps.intro: What your family owns: savings, property, land and investments.
items: Home value and what is still owed on it
Other property or farmland
Gold and savings accounts

cssSteps.title: Special circumstances
cssSteps.intro: A free-text section where you can explain anything the numbers don't show.
items: Medical costs, debts or a parent who lost their job
Relatives your family supports
Keep it short and factual

cssSteps.title: Review and submit
cssSteps.intro: Check every number once more, then pay the fee or apply for a fee waiver.
items: Compare totals with your papers line by line
Ask about a fee waiver if your family income is low
Save the PDF summary for IDOC

essayPrompts.label: Common App: a challenge or setback

sampleEssay:
Ever since I was young, I have been passionate about engineering.

In September 2024, Typhoon Yagi flooded our street in Hanoi. The water reached the second step of our house and stayed for three days. When it went down, half the neighbours had rice cookers, fans and motorbikes that would not turn on. My grandmother cried over her rice cooker because my grandfather bought it for her in 1998.

I opened it with a screwdriver from my father's toolbox. The thermal fuse was dead and the wires were covered in mud. I watched two videos, bought a fuse for 15,000 dong at the market and fixed it in one afternoon, and when it clicked on and the little red light came back my grandmother made me eat three bowls of rice even though I was not hungry at all and my mother laughed at both of us.

After that, people started knocking on our door. In two weeks I repaired 12 rice cookers and 5 fans. I kept a notebook of every fault. Most were the same three problems: wet fuses, rusted switches and loose wires. I started cleaning boards with alcohol before testing, which saved me hours.

I am a hardworking and dedicated person, and this experience taught me that engineering can change the world.

Now I lead my school's robotics club. I still keep the notebook. I want to study electrical engineering so I can design machines that survive the next flood instead of fixing them after it.
